SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY File No 379）
（手写：68. 9 40）
Date September 17, 1940

Subject Mrs. Anna Teseikin.

Made by D.S. Pavloff, Forwarded by D.S.J. Logan

（左侧手写批注：Sent, 18/9.）

Anna Gourievna TESEIKIN, nee DEMINA, Russian, was born on November 24, 1903 in Krasnoyarsk, Siberia. She is reported to have left Russia in 1922 and to have subsequently resided for a short period in Harbin. From 1922 to 1927 she resided for various periods in Dairen, Peking, Canton, Tsingtao and Shanghai, working as a dancing partner. In 1927 whilst residing in Canton and during one of her visits to Hongkong she met in the latter city a Russian, M.M. Teseikin whom she officially married in Hongkong on 30/5/27. In November of the same year Mr. and Mrs. Teseikin proceeded to Australia. However, after a 4 months stay in Australia she left her husband and returned to Shanghai.

She has since been residing in this city except for the summers which she spent in Tsingtao, where she also worked in the capacity of a dancing partner. It is also reported that during August - December 1934 she worked in the "Dalmonte" Cafe, Canton, which place is reputed to be an ordinary brothel in that city.

After her return to Shanghai she continued working as a dancing partner, but for the past 18 months she has not worked as she was supported by a member of the British Military Force, then stationed in Shanghai.

（左下角印章及手写：INDEXED (a) REGISTRY DATE 18/9/40 m）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处档案室 档案号 379）
（手写：68. 9 40）
日期：1940年9月17日

事由：安娜·特赛金夫人（Mrs. Anna Teseikin）。

撰写人：D.S. 帕夫洛夫（Pavloff），呈送人：D.S.J. 洛根（Logan）

（左侧手写批注：已发出，9月18日。）

安娜·古里耶芙娜·特赛金（Anna Gourievna TESEIKIN），婚前姓德米娜（DEMINA），俄罗斯人，1903年11月24日出生于西伯利亚克拉斯诺亚尔斯克。据报她于1922年离开俄国，随后在哈尔滨短暂居住。1922年至1927年间，她断续居住在大连、北平、广州、青岛和上海，职业为舞伴。1927年，她在广州居住期间，在一次访问香港时，在该市结识了一位俄罗斯人 M.M. 特赛金（Teseikin），两人于1927年5月30日在香港正式结婚。同年11月，特赛金夫妇前往澳大利亚。然而，在澳大利亚停留4个月后，她离开了丈夫，返回上海。

此后她一直居住在本市，除了夏季在青岛度过，在那里她也从事舞伴工作。另有报告称，1934年8月至12月期间，她在广州的“达尔蒙特”（Dalmonte）咖啡馆工作，该场所在该市被认为是一家普通的妓院。

回到上海后，她继续从事舞伴工作，但在过去18个月里她没有工作，因为由一名当时驻扎在上海的英军部队成员供养。

（左下角印章及手写：已索引 (a) 档案室日期 1940年9月18日 m）

Since her return to China from Australia
in 1928 she has been known under her maiden name,
Demina, and she has a passport issued in that name
by the Shanghai City Government, through the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, with which organization she is
registered as a Russian Emigrant.
While in Shanghai, she has not come to the
notice of the Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable nature.

（批：17/9）

自1928年从澳大利亚返回中国以来，
她一直以婚前姓氏德米娜（Demina）为人所知，
并且持有一本以上海市政府通过俄罗斯
难民委员会签发的该姓名护照，她已在该组织
注册为俄罗斯难民。
在上海期间，她并未因任何不良性质的活动
而引起警方的注意。

（批：9月17日）

D. S.

副总监（特别科）。
